userRequirements.capability: Every application dropdown has a filterable text field
userRequirements.deliveryNotes: All 97 select code locations use SearchableSelect, including notebook sections, templates, categories, campaigns, metadata types, filters and board sources. Focus/filter/bounds checks pass at 390/1024/1440 pixels; AST check/build guards future code.

userRequirements.capability: Prioritize visual campaign guides and notes, including affinity-style relationship webs
userRequirements.deliveryNotes: The approved fourteen-part party/equipment/consequence batch now connects the existing visual guides with original character progression, objective nodes, relationship event history, drawn journeys, location situations, ordered session media and unified wrap-up/continuity views. Broader visual workflows remain partial; online accounts/sharing remain later P5. Release 0.21 adds source-linked visual notebook cards and labeled connections alongside practical note capture, nested organization, templates and side-by-side writing/reference workflows.

userRequirements.capability: Automatically hyperlink matching words to their source entries
userRequirements.deliveryNotes: Prose reading views automatically link unambiguous titles/aliases to world-scoped source UUIDs, preserve text/formatting, and use published visible names for reader views. Existing links, code, URLs and ambiguous names are skipped. Read/write toggles, source previews, opt-out and recovery are tested. Matching is per text span; it does not rewrite documents or create stored backlinks. Explicit references remain available for stable associations through renames.

userRequirements.capability: Natural graph mouse gestures and relevant right-click menus
userRequirements.deliveryNotes: Affinity and shared relationship/family/hierarchy diagrams provide wheel zoom at the pointer, middle-button pan, contextual source/edge/camera actions and keyboard menus. Original left/keyboard arrangement persists. Actual browser gestures and edge-of-screen menu checks pass.

userRequirements.capability: Working Markdown image links and external portrait URLs
userRequirements.deliveryNotes: Markdown insert/paste previews and converts into original rich documents, with draft guards. Direct image and portrait URLs validate, render and persist across guides/cards/boards. Reader snapshots exclude unpublished portrait edits. Linked images require their host; canonical storage remains rich JSON, not Markdown source.

userRequirements.capability: Transfer the application and database/media to another bot or machine
userRequirements.deliveryNotes: Transfer launcher packages allowlisted source/build/setup files and a verified complete backup with checksums, destination instructions and protected new-folder restore. Clean restoration passes; environment recreation is required. External image URLs and browser-only preference boundaries are documented.
